rules: R6 overrides every conflicting historical value

The user-approved campus effect reference is authoritative for the external-road-to-campus relationship: the four surrounding city roads are straight and the campus wall/boundary varies independently inside them
大学路 and 致远路 remain straight east-west city-road centerlines; they must not bend to follow the campus wall
学府路 and 长虹路 remain straight north-south city-road centerlines; they must not bend to follow the campus wall
Corner curb/intersection radii are edge-treatment details only and may not deform external-road centerlines
Example JSON coordinates are excluded
Unfrozen parking/service facilities without permanent IDs are excluded
SVG coordinate mapping is frozen and may not auto-fit current geometry
One world meter equals one SVG user unit inside the map frame
World X maps right; world Z maps upward by inversion into SVG Y
Presentation profile may translate the map group but may not scale it
Step 4 layers remain the authoritative road/water/open-space engineering geometry baseline
Step 5 freezes building, residence and sports engineering geometry
Step 6 adds visual and landscape presentation hierarchy without changing Step 5 engineering geometry
Step 7 may rename/reorder top-level groups and rebuild labels/legend only; it may not move, resize or rotate Step 6 geometry
Step 7 validator compares every Step 6 geometry object against Step 7 in both engineering and presentation profiles
Figma delivery top-level layer IDs 01 through 19 are frozen after Step 7
Presentation SVG physically removes dense technical/legacy label groups instead of merely hiding them with CSS
Engineering SVG retains object IDs, technical object labels, engineering road labels and legacy audit label groups
Final presentation names follow R6 naming precedence; deprecated temporary life-area names are not reintroduced
Overview road labels include the four external roads plus selected named campus trunk/area roads; connector/feed/transit-only names remain engineering data and are not repeated on the overview
Building identity uses a restrained warm-gray / brick / neutral-glass / dark-metal family; disciplines do not receive saturated faction-like building colors
Jiangcheng Blue #173A5E is an identity/landmark accent, not a campus-wide wall color
Ginkgo Gold #C4A052 remains a limited identity and seasonal accent
LIFE-01 and LIFE-02 are life-science academic buildings and are distinct from LIFE-C/W/N/E/S student-life facilities
District washes use only source xRange/zRange control envelopes and are reference-only; DIST-NORTH-LIFE receives no invented district rectangle
Four life green hearts preserve the source 2-4ha range using residence centroids, a 2ha inner reference and a 4ha maximum outline
South-north ceremonial and east-west ecological axes remain presentation bands through source-supported anchors, not engineering roads
Cherry and ginkgo symbols are presentation samples derived from frozen seasonal paths, not individual vegetation asset coordinates
Riparian green buffers follow frozen lake/stream geometry for presentation only and have no engineering setback meaning
Undergraduate residence length remains the source range 78-82m; no hidden 80m footprint is introduced
HSP-02 remains an upper tower overlay on HSP-01 and never returns to the obsolete independent ground parcel
Step 8 uses Step 7 as its only content master and may modify release title/metadata only
Canonical release SVG filenames contain no Step number
Repeated Step 8 generation from unchanged inputs must be byte-identical
Release evidence intentionally omits timestamps and machine-specific paths
No raster image elements, externally linked images, external font files, @font-face, script or foreignObject dependencies are permitted in final release SVG files
Future coordinate or planning changes require R7 or a higher-priority patch and must be regenerated from CampusData; direct edits must not create a second coordinate truth
nextStep: SVG masterplan R6 release is FINAL CLOSED after correcting the external-road interpretation to the user-approved effect reference. Future planning changes require a new source patch; do not bend the four straight city-road centerlines to follow the campus wall.

effectReferenceBaseline.externalRoadRelationship: four straight orthogonal city side roads outside an independently varying campus boundary/perimeter wall
effectReferenceBaseline.cornerRule: intersection/curb corner treatment may round road edges, but must not bend the four road centerlines
